value.rationale: The exact coefficient moment threshold addresses a natural stochastic numerical-conditioning diagnostic for the newly published adaptive two-parameter method; the divergence of every momentum first absolute moment is dimension-independent despite bounded, mean-square-improving optimizer outputs. The result isolates a concrete cancellation mechanism and explains why averaging raw adaptive coefficients is statistically ill posed without asserting a floating-point failure theorem.
